text: There was a woman. <break time="0.8s" /> Who was beautiful. <break time="0.8s" /> Who started with every advantage. <break time="0.8s" /> And yet she had no luck. <break time="0.8s" /> For she had married for love. <break time="0.8s" /> And the love had turned to dust. <break time="0.8s" /> She had lovely children. <break time="0.8s" /> Yet she felt. <break time="0.8s" /> That they had been thrust upon her. <break time="0.8s" /> And whenever they were near she felt the center of her heart go hard. <break time="0.8s" /> Everybody said of her. <break time="0.8s" /> She is such a good mother. <break time="0.8s" /> And she adores her children. <break time="0.8s" /> But only she herself and her children. <break time="0.8s" /> Knew that it was not so. <break time="0.8s" /> They lived in a pleasant house. <break time="0.8s" /> With a garden and discreet servants. <break time="0.8s" /> And they felt themselves superior. <break time="0.8s" /> To anyone in the neighborhood. <break time="0.8s" /> Yet there was never enough money. <break time="0.8s" /> The mother had a small income. <break time="0.8s" /> And the father had a small income. <break time="0.8s" /> But it was not nearly enough. <break time="0.8s" /> For the social position. <break time="0.8s" /> Which they had to keep up. <break time="0.8s" /> The father went into town. <break time="0.8s" /> To some office. <break time="0.8s" /> But though he had good prospects. <break time="0.8s" /> These prospects never materialized. <break time="0.8s" /> And the mother. <break time="0.8s" /> Who tried this thing and the other. <break time="0.8s" /> Never succeeded either. <break time="0.8s" /> And so the house came to be haunted. <break time="0.8s" /> By an unspoken phrase. <break time="0.8s" /> There must be more money. <break time="0.8s" /> There must be more money. <break time="0.8s" /> Though nobody ever said it aloud. <break time="0.8s" /> The children could hear it all the time. <break time="0.8s" /> Especially at Christmas. <break time="0.8s" /> When the expensive toys filled the nursery. <break time="0.8s" /> And even the big rocking horse. <break time="0.8s" /> Behind the smart dolls house. <break time="0.8s" /> Seemed to hear it.
